about: Aperture-mass moments of the simulated maps of aperture_mass_statistic.ipynb (Section 3) at the four DES Y3 radii, each a mean over 25 realizations with the spread/sqrt(25) uncertainty: the measured <Map^2> of the Gaussian field against the power-spectrum prediction on the maps' Fourier grid, and the third moments (scaled by rms^3) of the Gaussian and of the quadratic non-Gaussian toy field.  Written by the export cell of the notebook's Section 3.
